summary: Under the Korean rules an advertising re-confirmation the game did not record by its due date pauses advertising: on the due date advertising still goes; from the next Asia/Seoul day it is suppressed as reconfirmation-overdue, while a service send goes on. Recording the listed notice resumes advertising, the next re-confirmation pauses it again two years later once it is overdue in turn, and a new consent restarts the count and resumes it. No push reached the player: the scheduler never ran.
